                [32m'\n'[39m +
                [32m'Build a single-page web application that lets a user visually compose a complex boolean filter as a tree of "chips" and apply it against a Typesense-backed product catalog. A local Typesense server (v26.0) is available; your application must index a provided dataset and translate the visually composed filter tree into a correct Typesense `filter_by` expression, then show the exact matching products.\n'[39m +
                [32m'\n'[39m +
                [32m'## Requirements\n'[39m +
                [32m'\n'[39m +
                [32m'* Provide a UI to build a filter tree made of **condition chips** and **nested AND / OR groups** (the UI must allow at least two levels of group nesting), apply the composed filter, and display the exact set of matching products (each result showing its product `id` and `name`) together with a total count of matches.\n'[39m +
                [32m'* Condition chips must support, at minimum: string equality, numeric comparison, inclusive numeric ranges, and set membership (a field value being one of a set of values; and for the array field, the array containing one of a set of values).\n'[39m +

                [32m'* The result of a filter tree must respect the grouping/precedence of its nodes, so two trees built from the same leaf conditions but grouped differently can yield different result sets.\n'[39m +
                [32m'* The reported matches must be the complete set Typesense returns for the composed filter, even when more than ten documents match.\n'[39m +
                [32m'\n'[39m +
                [32m'## Dataset\n'[39m +
                [32m'\n'[39m +
                [32m'A dataset is provided at `/home/user/filterchip/data/products.jsonl` (JSONL; one product object per line). Your server MUST index exactly these documents (no additions, no omissions) into a Typesense collection named `products`. The documents have these fields:\n'[39m +

                [32m'\n'[39m +
                [32m'* Project path: /home/user/filterchip\n'[39m +

                [32m'### `POST /api/filter`\n'[39m +

                [32m'Request body (JSON):\n'[39m +
                [32m'\n'[39m +
                [32m'```json\n'[39m +
                [32m'{ "filter": <Node> }\n'[39m +
                [32m'```\n'[39m +
                [32m'\n'[39m +
                [32m'A `<Node>` is either a **Group** or a **Condition**.\n'[39m +
                [32m'\n'[39m +
                [32m'Group node:\n'[39m +
                [32m'\n'[39m +
                [32m'```json\n'[39m +

                [32m'\n'[39m +
                [32m'A group whose `children` array is empty applies no constraint (it matches every document).\n'[39m +

                [32m'Condition node:\n'[39m +

                [32m'\n'[39m +
                [32m'Comparators and their `value` shapes:\n'[39m +
                [32m'\n'[39m +

                content: [32m"const express = require('express');\n"[39m +
                  [32m"const fs = require('fs');\n"[39m +
                  [32m"const path = require('path');\n"[39m +
                  [32m'\n'[39m +
                  [32m'const app = express();\n'[39m +
                  [32m'app.use(express.json());\n'[39m +
                  [32m"app.use(express.static(path.join(__dirname, 'public')));\n"[39m +
                  [32m'\n'[39m +
                  [32m"const TYPESENSE_HOST = 'http://127.0.0.1:8108';\n"[39m +
                  [32m"const API_KEY = 'XiKwGzOimJpb7rQhnIYHPTGjm6X9xhpO';\n"[39m +
                  [32m"const collectionName = 'products';\n"[39m +
                  [32m'\n'[39m +
                  [32m"const VALID_FIELDS = new Set(['id', 'name', 'category', 'brand', 'price', 'rating', 'tags']);\n"[39m +
                  [32m'\n'[39m +
                  [32m'// Helper to escape string values for Typesense filter_by\n'[39m +
                  [32m'function escapeValue(val) {\n'[39m +
                  [32m"  if (typeof val === 'string') {\n"[39m +
                  [32m"    const escaped = val.replace(/`/g, '\\\\`');\n"[39m +
                  [32m'    return `\\`${escaped}\\``;\n'[39m +
                  [32m'  }\n'[39m +
                  [32m'  return val;\n'[39m +
                  [32m'}\n'[39m +
                  [32m'\n'[39m +
                  [32m'// Recursive compiler from Node to Typesense filter_by string\n'[39m +
                  [32m'function compileNode(node) {\n'[39m +
                  [32m"  if (!node) return '';\n"[39m +
                  [32m'\n'[39m +
                  [32m'  // 1. Group Node\n'[39m +
                  [32m'  if (node.op !== undefined) {\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    const op = String(node.op).toLowerCase();\n'[39m +
                  [32m"    if (op !== 'and' && op !== 'or') {\n"[39m +
                  [32m'      const err = new Error(`Invalid operator: ${op}`);\n'[39m +
                  [32m'      err.statusCode = 400;\n'[39m +
                  [32m'      throw err;\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    }\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    \n'[39m +
                  [32m'    const children = node.children || [];\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    if (!Array.isArray(children)) {\n'[39m +
                  [32m'      const err = new Error(`Children must be an array`);\n'[39m +
                  [32m'      err.statusCode = 400;\n'[39m +
                  [32m'      throw err;\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    }\n'[39m +
                  [32m'\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    const compiledChildren = [];\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    for (const child of children) {\n'[39m +
                  [32m'      const compiled = compileNode(child);\n'[39m +
                  [32m'      if (compiled) {\n'[39m +
                  [32m'        compiledChildren.push(compiled);\n'[39m +
                  [32m'      }\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    }\n'[39m +
                  [32m'\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    if (compiledChildren.length === 0) {\n'[39m +
                  [32m"      return '';\n"[39m +
                  [32m'    }\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    if (compiledChildren.length === 1) {\n'[39m +
                  [32m'      return compiledChildren[0];\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    }\n'[39m +
                  [32m'\n'[39m +
                  [32m"    const separator = op === 'and' ? ' && ' : ' || ';\n"[39m +
                  [32m'    return `(${compiledChildren.join(separator)})`;\n'[39m +
                  [32m'  }\n'[39m +
                  [32m'\n'[39m +
                  [32m'  // 2. Condition Node\n'[39m +
                  [32m'  const { field, cmp, value } = node;\n'[39m +
                  [32m'  if (!field) {\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    const err = new Error(`Missing field in condition node`);\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    err.statusCode = 400;\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    throw err;\n'[39m +
                  [32m'  }\n'[39m +
                  [32m'\n'[39m +
                  [32m'  if (!VALID_FIELDS.has(field)) {\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    const err = new Error(`Invalid field: ${field}`);\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    err.statusCode = 400;\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    throw err;\n'[39m +
                  [32m'  }\n'[39m +
                  [32m'\n'[39m +
                  [32m'  if (!cmp) {\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    const err = new Error(`Missing cmp in condition node for field ${field}`);\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    err.statusCode = 400;\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    throw err;\n'[39m +
                  [32m'  }\n'[39m +
                  [32m'\n'[39m +
                  [32m'  switch (cmp) {\n'[39m +
                  [32m"    case 'eq':\n"[39m +
                  [32m'      return `${field}:=${escapeValue(value)}`;\n'[39m +
                  [32m"    case 'ne':\n"[39m +
                  [32m'      return `${field}:!=${escapeValue(value)}`;\n'[39m +
                  [32m"    case 'gt':\n"[39m +
                  [32m'      return `${field}:>${value}`;\n'[39m +
                  [32m"    case 'gte':\n"[39m +
                  [32m'      return `${field}:>=${value}`;\n'[39m +
                  [32m"    case 'lt':\n"[39m +
                  [32m'      return `${field}:<${value}`;\n'[39m +
                  [32m"    case 'lte':\n"[39m +
                  [32m'      return `${field}:<=${value}`;\n'[39m +
                  [32m"    case 'between': {\n"[39m +
                  [32m'      if (!Array.isArray(value) || value.length !== 2) {\n'[39m +
                  [32m"        const err = new Error(`Invalid value for 'between' comparator: ${JSON.stringify(value)}`);\n"[39m +

                  [32m'      }\n'[39m +
                  [32m'      const escapedValues = value.map(val => escapeValue(val));\n'[39m +

                  [32m'    default: {\n'[39m +

                  [32m'// Endpoint: POST /api/filter\n'[39m +
                  [32m"app.post('/api/filter', async (req, res) => {\n"[39m +

                  [32m'\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    const tsRes = await fetch(url, {\n'[39m +
                  [32m"      headers: { 'X-TYPESENSE-API-KEY': API_KEY }\n"[39m +
                  [32m'    });\n'[39m +
                  [32m'\n'[39m +

            [32m'Before executing the command, please follow these steps:\n'[39m +

            [32m'\n'[39m +
            [32m'# Committing changes with git\n'[39m +

            [32m'Git Safety Protocol:\n'[39m +
